name: OVHcloud
tagline: French cloud giant with shared hosting, VPS, dedicated and cloud servers
description: OVHcloud is a French infrastructure provider spanning budget shared web hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and public cloud, run through its own OVHcloud Control Panel (Manager) rather than cPanel by default.
about: OVHcloud isn't just a raw-compute company — it runs three separate hosting product lines under one account: Eco/Business/Agencies shared web hosting (starting around $1.89-3.59/month intro), VPS (from about $4.54/month for 2 vCores/4GB RAM), and dedicated/cloud servers for larger workloads. Shared hosting and VPS both run on OVHcloud's own Manager control panel by default; cPanel and Plesk exist only as paid add-ons on VPS and dedicated plans, not as the standard interface.

As with most budget-tier hosts, the advertised entry price is a first-term promotional rate that jumps sharply on renewal — Business-range plans intro around $2.39-8.29/month but renew at roughly $7.09-23.59/month, and the discount tends to be steeper the longer the commitment. Check the renewal price for your specific plan and term before buying on the headline number alone.
policies: OVHcloud offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on most hosting and VPS plans.

faqs.q: Is OVHcloud only for VPS and dedicated servers, or does it have cheap shared hosting too?
faqs.a: Both. OVHcloud runs three separate lines: budget shared web hosting (Eco/Business/Agencies ranges), VPS, and dedicated/cloud servers — so it competes with both budget shared hosts and raw-compute providers depending on which product you pick.

faqs.q: Will my OVHcloud price go up after the first term?
faqs.a: Yes. Like most budget hosts, OVHcloud's advertised prices are first-term promotional rates. Business-range shared hosting plans that intro at roughly $2.39-8.29/month can renew at $7.09-23.59/month depending on the plan and commitment length — check the renewal rate on the pricing page before buying.

faqs.q: Does OVHcloud offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes — OVHcloud backs its plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can request a refund if it's not a good fit.
